Ağ hedefi taranmaz. No network target is scanned. The result shows the finding count, severity distribution, report summary and at most 200 findings (rule, CWE, project-relative file:line, description); raw code is not shown and no result is stored. Findings require expert verification.

en: Yalnız DGX üzerindeki yönetici sabitli sentetik 127.0.0.1 fixture ve tek GET /api/ping şeması. Genel localhost veya staging API taraması değildir. Testcase sayısı gerçek HTTP isteği değildir; temiz sonuç güvenlik onayı sayılmaz.
column3: Only the administrator-pinned synthetic 127.0.0.1 fixture on the DGX and a single GET /api/ping schema. This is not a general localhost or staging API scan. The testcase count is not real HTTP requests; a clean result is not a security approval.

column3: Only the root package-lock.json (npm v2/v3) of a project in the Sniper service user's home is temporarily copied. npm audit queries official npm registry security advisories for package names and versions. No packages are installed and no fixes or project scripts are run; no external site target is scanned. The result only shows aggregate counts and is not stored.
